Elemental.name: Convection
Elemental.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 10%.

Elemental.name: Concussion
Elemental.description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 5%.

Elemental.name: Elemental Warding
Elemental.description: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 10%.

Elemental.name: Reverberation
Elemental.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 1.0 sec.

Elemental.name: Call of Flame
Elemental.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 15%.

Elemental.name: Elemental Devastation
Elemental.description: Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 9% for 10 sec.

Elemental.name: Elemental Focus
Elemental.description: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Elemental.name: Elemental Alacrity
Elemental.description: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.

Elemental.name: Improved Fire Nova
Elemental.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 4 sec.

Elemental.name: Eye of the Storm
Elemental.description: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 70%.

Elemental.name: Call of Thunder
Elemental.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

Elemental.name: Elemental Reach
Elemental.description: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 6 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by 15 yards.

Elemental.name: Lightning Overload
Elemental.description: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

Elemental.name: Earthbound
Elemental.description: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

Elemental.name: Elemental Fury
Elemental.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

Elemental.name: Lava Burst
Elemental.description: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing <!--ppl40:48:164:90-->150 to 192 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

Enhancement.name: Earth's Grasp
Enhancement.description: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 50% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 20%.

Enhancement.name: Thundering Strikes
Enhancement.description: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.

Enhancement.name: Guardian Totems
Enhancement.description: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 2 sec.

Enhancement.name: Mental Dexterity
Enhancement.description: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

Enhancement.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
Enhancement.description: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

Enhancement.name: Improved Lightning Shield
Enhancement.description: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.

Enhancement.name: Elemental Weapons
Enhancement.description: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 20%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 40% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 15%.

Enhancement.name: Shamanistic Focus
Enhancement.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

Enhancement.name: Anticipation
Enhancement.description: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 6%.

Enhancement.name: Flurry
Enhancement.description: Increases your attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Enhancement.name: Stormstrike
Enhancement.description: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

Enhancement.name: Spirit Weapons
Enhancement.description: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

Enhancement.name: Mental Quickness
Enhancement.description: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

Enhancement.name: Improved Stormstrike
Enhancement.description: When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

Enhancement.name: Maelstrom Weapon
Enhancement.description: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Enhancement.name: Rage of the Farseer
Enhancement.description: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

Restoration.name: Improved Healing Wave
Restoration.description: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.5 sec.

Restoration.name: Totemic Focus
Restoration.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 25%.

Restoration.name: Mindfulness
Restoration.description: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Restoration.name: Natural Grace
Restoration.description: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 15%.

Restoration.name: Tidal Focus
Restoration.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

Restoration.name: Improved Reincarnation
Restoration.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 20 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 20%.

Restoration.name: Ancestral Healing
Restoration.description: Increases your target's armor value by 25% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

Restoration.name: Healing Focus
Restoration.description: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

Restoration.name: Water Shield
Restoration.description:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

Restoration.name: Tidal Mastery
Restoration.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 5%.

Restoration.name: Restorative Totems
Restoration.description: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.

Restoration.name: Mana Tide Totem
Restoration.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

Restoration.name: Healing Way
Restoration.description: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 25%.

Restoration.name: Nature's Swiftness
Restoration.description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Restoration.name: Purification
Restoration.description: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

Restoration.name: Riptide
Restoration.description: Heals a friendly target for <!--ppl40:48:480:370-->486 to 534, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.
